Dialogs.Dialog: That's right. You hear us, Doc?
Affirmative.
Great, I wasn't expecting less!
Aaand everything set and ready to go.
Those are Streptococcus Sanguinis, right? Seeing them in this size is quite intimidating…
Understandable, but, still, they shouldn't be aggressive.
Seems I can't get across yet.
Maybe try going downwards, there should be some cell that you can absorb. To gain a charge ability, you know?
I know, Luke, I know.
Don't worry about the Eosinophil; the MHK suit will keep you safe.
You don't say!
Feel any different?
I feel… lighter. Getting across should be a walk in the park.
Don't you mean jump, Doc?
Do make sure to get that sample first, please.
Those things there don't seem so friendly.
One less to go.
Wow Doc, you're on a streak today!
What are you acting so surprised for?
So, downwards it is, no?
HOLD ON! QUICK, STEADY HIM!
What are you-?
Hey, Doc. It seems like all connection was lost when you fell down the trachea. Uhm…the patient…he…started convulsing violently.
As soon as his vitals are stabilized, we'll try to get you out. In the meantime, take care, please.
How is it going down there, Doc? Out here it's taking longer than we expected, the patient is not getting any better.
We are trying to stabilize him with further medicines. Theo is a bit iffy about it, but there's nothing else we can do.
Hi Doc, it's Luke… again… The patient is not showing any signs of improvement, in fact, he is getting even worse.
We've tried getting in touch with the central, but no one answered, which is weird. Rest assured, I'm sure they'll soon reach out. Be safe, we'll keep in contact.
The virus is deteriorating the patient's body bit by bit, and its vital functions seem to be changing.
Some living cells were also infected and transformed into…monstrous versions of themselves.
Hey Doc, Luke speaking. There's no news from the central.We are trying to remain calm, but it seems like it's taking a toll on Theo.
He is being more unbearable than usual. Also, the patient won't stop trembling, it seems like anesthesia is losing its effect. Hope you're safe.
Hey, well… we had to double the patient's sedative dosis, but it seems that this is just the calm before the storm. I don't know why, but Theo lashed out.
Right now Morgan is trying to cool him down. Also, we still haven't heard from the central. Something is definitely off.
So…Theo went off the rails and he…jumped Morgan. He injured Morgan to the point of bleeding. We had to tie him up to prevent any other possible attacks.
This couldn't get any worse, could it? Watch your back.
The patient's heart has been infected by the virus, I've never seen such a thing. It seems as if like the virus is modifying the patient's genetic material.
I'm afraid it will get to a point of symbiosis.
Hi. We've spotted a wound on Theo's arm, we have an inkling the illness might spread via physical injuries, which means…Morgan's life is on the line too.
We are so screwed.
Morgan is helping out in every way that he can, but there's nothing much we can do out here. He knows…his time is almost up.
All entrance and exit doors were blocked, we are locked shut in this stupid room. No one is coming to the rescue, and frankly, I think we were set up.
I'm sure it must be hard down there as well, but, I need you to push through, please.
Doc, Morgan…he…killed himself. It was the hardest thing we ever had to agree upon, but, he…wanted to go before the illness took over him.
I'll have to…do something about Theo. I'm unsure if I can.
You all wouldn't believe how critical the situation has become unless you'd see it with your own eyes.
It seems like the virus is exerting some sort of control over the body's living organisms.
I must make haste, otherwise I'm not sure I'll make it out alive.
Theo… is gone… Doc… I… did it. I had no other choice. I’m the only one left standing here. I… life faded from his eyes and I just… watched.
…I’ve stopped trying to reach outside, it’s no use. Listen, if you’re still there… please, you need to defeat the virus.
There’s really no way out, but… the samples that you can gather… will surely cause a breakthrough.
If anyone can do this, I know it’s you.
I think… this is how this ends for us. I’m… sorry I couldn’t do more than what I’ve done. I wish… we would’ve had more time and… if only things hadn’t taken such a turn… forget it.
Doc, I’m…really glad we got to work together in this life. I hope I can bump into you on my next one. I have to…say goodbye now, but I know you’ve got this. Don’t miss me too much…see you.
